label: Multi-omic analysis reveals brain-blood concordance and persistent neuroimmune reprogramming with stress and toxicant exposure in a mouse model of Gulf War Illness.
summary: Gulf War Illness (GWI) is a chronic neuroimmune condition affecting veterans of the 1990-91 Gulf War. Current treatments primarily target symptom relief, and the biological mechanisms underlying GWI remain poorly understood.
